'''Prexiar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Steniplis sector/Legends|Steniplis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet had great freshwater [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] and vast [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]]. The [[Pirates of Prexiar]] operated an [[Pirates of Prexiar base|outpost]] there.<ref name="Pirates" />
